title: DOW-UAP-PR030, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, 2023
what_is_it: A short (10-second) infrared surveillance video clip submitted by the US military as an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) case.
interpretation_warnings: The video is only 10 seconds long and the phenomenon appears for roughly 1-2 seconds, giving very limited data.
The case is officially unresolved — no identification of the objects has been made.
No source text could be extracted from the PDF; this analysis relies on war.gov metadata and the official video description only.
The US government explicitly states the description is informational and should not be read as an analytical judgment, investigative conclusion, or factual determination about the event.
The objects are described only as 'areas of contrast' in an infrared sensor — this indicates a thermal signature, not a confirmed physical craft.
Single-source: the footage comes from one military sensor with no corroborating data provided.

key_facts.source_quote: from an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform in 2023
